metric_definitions.business_question: How quickly are new business-hours Sales leads receiving their first response?
metric_definitions.population: Serra Honda 21043 Sales leads, period 2026-08-24..2026-08-30, Originated After Hours == No (business-hours-originated)
metric_definitions.formula: median(Actual Response Time (Min)) over leads where Originated After Hours == No; blank Actual Response Time excluded from the median (missing is not zero)
metric_definitions.evidence_ref: reuse of accepted Leads artifact 39f05774…; leads-real-golden.json (Honda: Actual Response Time populated=54/blanks=65)
metric_definitions.explainability_ref: Median first-response minutes for business-hours leads; blanks are unworked/untracked and excluded (never counted as zero).
metric_definitions.evidence_index_ref: PKT-02-01 supporting-data index: Actual Response Time distribution, blank counts, business-hours filter

metric_definitions.business_question: What share of business-hours Sales leads are missing a first contact attempt, first customer contact, or actual response time (unworked/untracked)?
metric_definitions.population: Serra Honda 21043 Sales leads, period 2026-08-24..2026-08-30, Originated After Hours == No (business-hours population)
metric_definitions.numerator: count of business-hours leads with ANY of {First Contact Attempt, First Customer Contact, Actual Response Time (Min)} blank
metric_definitions.denominator: count of business-hours leads (Originated After Hours == No)
metric_definitions.evidence_ref: reuse of accepted Leads artifact 39f05774…; leads-real-golden.json (Honda: first_customer_contact_blanks=63)
metric_definitions.explainability_ref: Share of business-hours leads with a gap in contact/response tracking; each blank counted once (no double count); missing never treated as zero.
metric_definitions.evidence_index_ref: PKT-02-01 supporting-data index: per-field blank counts within business-hours population

metric_definitions.business_question: Do business-hours leads receive a first HUMAN response within target, measured from the authoritative opening boundary?
metric_definitions.population: Serra Honda 21043 business-hours Sales leads (opening boundary + first-human timestamp required)
metric_definitions.evidence_ref: Direct origination/after-hours exists, but the AUTHORITATIVE opening boundary and a first-HUMAN response timestamp are NOT present in the current Leads source; do NOT infer opening from generic hours or from Adjusted Response Time.
metric_definitions.next_action: finite investigation: one help-contract pass + one read-only UI discovery pass + one controlled probe to prove an authoritative opening boundary and a first-human timestamp (no Vin/UI action performed in this authoring step)
metric_definitions.explainability_ref: Held open: authoritative opening boundary + first-human timestamp not directly available; no proxy permitted.

metric_definitions.business_question: Was the first response to a Sales lead a HUMAN or an automated/system action, and how fast (within business hours)?
metric_definitions.population: Serra Honda 21043 business-hours Sales leads (auto-vs-human actor classification + timestamps required)
metric_definitions.evidence_ref: A direct system/auto-vs-human actor classification with timestamps is NOT present in the current Leads source; do NOT infer human/auto from channel or direction.
metric_definitions.next_action: finite investigation: one help-contract pass + one read-only UI discovery pass + one controlled probe to prove a direct auto-vs-human actor classification (no Vin/UI action performed in this authoring step)
metric_definitions.explainability_ref: Held open: direct auto-vs-human actor classification not available; no proxy from channel/direction permitted.

metric_definitions.business_question: Which Sales reps are responding slower than the store, and where should coaching focus?
metric_definitions.population: Serra Honda 21043 Sales leads with a populated Actual Response Time, grouped by Sales Rep (pseudonymized, ephemeral)
metric_definitions.formula: per-rep mean(Actual Response Time (Min)) minus store median(Actual Response Time (Min)); Sales Rep pseudonymized to an ephemeral tenant-scoped id and NEVER persisted as a name; customer/VIN/body content excluded
metric_definitions.evidence_ref: reuse of accepted Leads artifact 39f05774…; leads-real-golden.json (Actual Response Time populated=54)
metric_definitions.explainability_ref: Per-rep first-response mean vs the store median; reps shown by pseudonymized label only (no name persisted); blanks excluded (missing is not zero).
metric_definitions.evidence_index_ref: PKT-02-01 supporting-data index: per-rep response distribution vs store median (pseudonymized)
